_instructions: Fill in one entry per player character. speaker_id maps to pyannote output (SPEAKER_00 etc.) - leave empty if unknown. appearance and distinctive_features are injected directly into image prompts so be specific and visual.

characters.name: Character Name
characters.appearance: e.g. tall human fighter with short black hair, weathered face, scar across left cheek
characters.distinctive_features: e.g. battered steel plate armor, red cloak, longsword at hip
